product: Postgres password authentication is now disabled by default for new Lakebase…
tagline: New Lakebase projects now have native Postgres password authentication disabled by default.
what_it_does: New Lakebase projects now have native Postgres password authentication disabled by default. Existing projects are unaffected. To allow native Postgres roles to connect with static passwords, enable password connections in project settings.
why_it_matters: The Lakebase App generates a secure password automatically.
